A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DSP research. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison despite reformatting and reorganization.

before.justification: v3 reports original GPU experiments measuring end-to-end performance, weak and strong scaling, inference latency, and memory consumption in Figures 5–9.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments, adds separately reported Megatron comparisons, and reports communication timings in Appendix Table 9.

M1.justification: DSP retains the same stage-boundary resharding procedure and Switch, Split, and Gather primitives. The tensor transformations and communication strategy are unchanged; removing the API example does not establish a method change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same video-derived spatial-temporal Transformer-2D workloads. No dataset, application domain, or task is added. The new 8M-sequence communication measurement extends experimental settings within this coverage.

E2.justification: v3 describes Megatron-SP but labels its single Megatron plot series Megatron-LM. Figures 5–9 in v4 retain that series under Megatron-SP and add a distinct Megatron-LM series. DeepSpeed-Ulysses and Ring Attention remain, making this a limited comparator expansion.

E3.justification: v4 introduces an 8M-sequence communication-latency measurement in Table 9, although its detailed configuration is unspecified. The retained model configurations, hardware, end-to-end parallelism settings, and scaling workloads match after accounting for appendix and table moves.

E4.justification: Appendix Table 9 adds a component-level comparison of communication operations, frequencies, and latency, providing additional evidence concerning DSP's communication-overhead argument. The existing scaling and memory analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, statistical tests, or uncertainty estimates. The black outlines in scaling plots indicate ideal scaling, and memory-bar shading distinguishes allocated and cached memory.

E6.justification: The retained bar values in Figures 5–9 match, including the relabeled Megatron series; v4 adds separate Megatron-LM results. New Table 9 reports communication times of 914 ms for DSP, 5828 ms for DS-Ulysses, 8412 ms for Megatron-LM, and 51908 ms for Megatron-SP. These are additional results, not improvements to existing DSP measurements.

T1.justification: v4 extends the communication-cost accounting to Megatron-LM: four all-reduces per two-block layer yield 8M communication per device. Table 8 also explicitly tabulates collective-operation costs. The optimization formulation, DSP transformations, and existing cost expressions remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The introduction newly asserts that data and pipeline parallelism cannot reduce memory cost or inference time and that sequence parallelism is the only option, strengthening the necessity framing. DSP's principal contributions and headline throughput and communication-reduction claims remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 5.2 changes the explanation for super-linear intra-node scaling from reduced optimizer and gradient overhead to efficient communication. The memory discussion also explicitly includes Megatron-LM. The limitations concerning single-dimensional models and global operations already appear in v3 and are retained.

D1.justification: v4 removes the front-page code pointer and Appendix A.4/Figure 11, including API signatures, the usage example, and dataloader replication guidance. It adds Megatron-LM implementation provenance and a diagram, while retaining the existing hardware and model-setting disclosures.

R1.justification: v4 expands the discussion and positioning of the already cited Megatron-LM as a distinct comparator, including a dedicated related-work paragraph. It also adds a Langley (2000) bibliography entry. The broader literature coverage and DSP novelty positioning remain substantially the same.

P1.justification: Most prose and the overall narrative are retained. v4 edits the introduction and communication analysis, reorders the method subsections and appendix sections, labels limitations and future work explicitly, and adds an appendix roadmap and generic impact statement.

P2.justification: v4 substantially recomposes the paper into a two-column conference layout. It expands comparison plots and Table 3, adds Tables 8–9, redraws Figure 10 with Megatron-LM and without the Ring diagram, and removes API Figure 11. Existing overview and switching illustrations are reordered and recaptioned.

improvement.justification: Separately reporting Megatron-LM and Megatron-SP improves comparator clarity, and Table 9 adds direct communication measurements. However, v4 removes the code pointer and complete API example while retaining ease of use as a core contribution. The new timing configuration is also underspecified. These gains in comparative evidence and losses in reproducibility guidance do not establish a reliable net quality direction.
